deals.evidence: The Chicago White Sox today announced that Jerry Reinsdorf and Justin Ishbia have reached a long-term investment agreement
deals.headline: Reinsdorf and Justin Ishbia agree long-term investment and path to control
deals.investor: Justin Ishbia (with Mat and Jeff Ishbia)
deals.summary: Ishbia makes capital infusions as a limited partner in 2025 and 2026 to pay down debt and fund operations; Reinsdorf may sell control to Ishbia 2029-2033, and Ishbia may acquire it after the 2034 season. Sportico reports the Ishbias first bought a mid-single-digit percentage. BDT & MSD Partners advised the club.

ownership_summary: A limited partnership headed by chairman Jerry Reinsdorf, which bought the club in January 1981; the Reinsdorf family holds the controlling interest. Under a June 2025 agreement Justin Ishbia (with brother Mat and father Jeff) invests as a limited partner in 2025-26 and gains options to acquire control from 2029.
